description: This file implements an MQTT backend for Zephyr shell, managing MQTT connection, subscription, publishing, and network events, with detailed handling of MQTT events and socket communication.

methods.name: shell_mqtt_get_devid
methods.description: Weak function to retrieve device ID, used for MQTT client ID.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the shell MQTT transport, setting up MQTT client, work queues, and network callbacks.

methods.name: uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes the transport, placeholder for cleanup.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the MQTT shell backend and registers network event callbacks.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data over MQTT, buffering and scheduling publish work.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data received via MQTT into provided buffer.

methods.name: shell_backend_mqtt_get_ptr
methods.description: Returns pointer to the shell MQTT transport instance.
